# Meridin & Co™ | Global Cyber Intelligence

Premium cyber intelligence and digital security consultancy for high-value organizations and individuals.

## Core Mission
To provide absolute discretion and world-class technical security oversight for the discerning elite.

## Services
- **Security Infrastructure Review**: Deep-dive audits of digital perimeters.
- **Public Data Risk Analysis**: Exposure checking across public and private databases.
- **Privacy Support**: Reducing digital footprints for high-net-worth individuals.
- **Monitoring & Audits**: Continuous security baseline verification.
- **Incident Response**: Specialized recovery support for security breaches.

## Engagement Protocol
Meridin & Co™ operates exclusively via secure digital channels. All transactions are conducted using cryptographic protocols (Cryptocurrency).
